style: v5.28's rules: the registry's words exactly, no added capitals, at most one added ellipsis, a tag that names an EMOTION. Two takes per line, picked by measure (length, rate) and by ear-proxy (transcription echoes the prompt, so a pause before the first word is the only tell of a spoken tag).

lines.text: Ever since I was young, I loved picking things up from the ground.
lines.prompt: [warm, fond, remembering] Ever since I was young, I loved picking things up from the ground.

lines.text: Sometimes it was just random leaves that I found interesting.
lines.prompt: [fond, a little amused] Sometimes it was just random leaves… that I found interesting.

lines.text: Sometimes I found thrown-away toys that I liked, when nobody else did.
lines.prompt: [quietly proud, tender] Sometimes I found thrown-away toys that I liked, when nobody else did.

lines.text: And if I'm lucky... sometimes I find money.
lines.prompt: [a small grin, mischievous] And if I'm lucky... sometimes I find money.

lines.text: This time however... this time was different.
lines.prompt: [quiet, uneasy, the smile gone] This time however... this time was different.
